title: Sensitivity lower bound at balanced measure
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ be measurable with standard Gaussian measure $1/2$. For every $\theta\in[0,\pi/2]$, its Gaussian rotation sensitivity, the probability that membership in $A$ changes under the rotation $g\mapsto\cos(\theta)g+\sin(\theta)h$ for independent standard Gaussian vectors $g,h$, satisfies $$\frac{\theta}{\pi}\le s_A(\theta).$$
hypotheses_covered: The standard Gaussian measure of $A$ equals $1/2$
